summary.short: Implements the RIGI investment-incentive regime (Law 27.742, Title VII) for single-project vehicles making large investments in listed sectors, including technology and artificial intelligence. Covers eligibility, minimum investment, admission, import and local-supplier rules, tax, FX and stability benefits, sanctions and arbitration. Binding; effective on publication.
summary.long: Decree 749/2024 approves the regulation of Title VII of Law 27.742 (arts. 164–228), the RIGI incentive regime for large investments. Eligible are single-project vehicles (VPU) carrying out one planned project in a listed sector, including technology (software, robotics, artificial intelligence), energy, mining, infrastructure, tourism, forestry, steel, and oil and gas. Projects must meet sector minimum investments in qualifying assets. Applications go to the Application Authority (Ministry of Economy), which must decide within 45 business days; the decree adds a non-distortion test, a Panel RIGI for disputes, and supplier-development duties. Imported goods are covered by supplier registration, customs-duty exemption, destination checks and penalties. Tax benefits include optional accelerated depreciation, VAT tax-credit certificates and dividend rates; FX rules govern export proceeds. Stability protects tax and customs treatment for 30 years. Sanctions, suspension, withdrawal, termination and transitional provisions complete the text. Later amendments by decrees 940/2024, 105/2026, 748/2026 and 868/2026 are reflected in the text.
